bio: What a wonderful, endearing place! This charming 19C farmhouse is a true idyll that is perfectly at home in this rural village location – it's well worth the trip out here! The cosy interior and pergola simply make you feel right at home: comfortable, yet stylish and elegant, lovingly decorated with attention to detail. The absolute highlight in summer is the fantastic terrace surrounded by old trees and a view of the countryside! Kurt Mösching's kitchen delivers modernised classics – these are dishes that are sophisticated in terms of flavours and technique and revolve around the excellent ingredients that go into them.
